column7: A v0.96.x replica running during a rolling upgrade cannot replace the v2 audit retention anchor with the v1 layout (which drops the cumulative purged count for good): on PostgreSQL a BEFORE UPDATE trigger refuses that write, so the older binary purge rolls back whole. The schema epoch floor 3 stops older binaries from starting afterwards. Not covered: a DELETE followed by INSERT of the anchor row bypasses a BEFORE UPDATE trigger; no released binary does that (v0.96.3 writes the anchor only through SetSystemMetadata's INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE and never deletes it, checked 2026-10-31), so it needs a DB-write actor, not an old replica.
